- I feel less overwhelmed & can just tackle one task at a time

Check it out - whether or not you have ADHD, this might just be the to-do list for you.

title: Amazing app for my adhd and a much happier life!
body:
I struggle with time management, time blindness, prioritising, planning, overwhelm etc etc. I tried llama life free for two weeks and found it so helpful. TBH I was reluctant to pay because I was not sure if I would stick to it and I don’t have much cash so I tried to find a free alternative. 

I tried loads of the mainstream ones recommended- but they were all so complex and overwhelming. 

Llama life looks deceiving simple. But it works amazingly for me. I had a little system in my house of index cards in a box. My friend suggested it to me because I get so overwhelmed with lists. 

Each index card had a task on it and I’d put them in a box standing up with  little headers- urgent, medium, long term. A list totally overwhelms me but I found that having each task on a separate card, I could more easily choose what was important and shuffle around my order. And put some back in the box. 

I also hate tech of any kind so not keen on apps but came across a podcast with llama life creator which inspired me to then search for the app. 

It’s like my little cards plus it’s colourful and pretty to look at. The confetti after each task helps boost me a little. I can shuffle my cards around into different orders. I can prioritise by moving some onto the ‘ not now’ list so I can just focus on what I’m doing today in the next few hours.  The time I’ve estimated for each task is then translated into real time at the top of the task so I know when I finish a task and whether the MANY tasks I’m  planning will fit into my day.

I nearly always run over on my estimations of time. I love that you can choose to let time roll over so you can see how long u actually spent. And the little summary page is brilliant at the end of the day. I take a screenshot at the end of my eve and then clear the completed tasks for the next day. With time ( if I get round to it) I’d like to look at my screenshots of data and see if I can get better at judging time. 

Another handy thing is if I’ve planned e.g. put washing out and then something distracts me while doing this task and the timer is ticking away, I can add it to my task description so I can still track my activity and time taken. 

I honestly never write reviews and I never thought I’d love an app on my phone but after two weeks without it, I really wanted to buy it because it feels so helpful for keeping me focused. I am so happy to support fellow adhd creators for the time and clarity of this app. I thank them from the bottom of my never ending bottomless to-do list! And heart 💙👍

title: The best productivity app for me!
body:
It is a bit buggy at times as it disconnects from Todoist. But I guess it is because it is a brand new app.

But it deserves all 5 stars 🌟 

It helps me understand how long will it take to end chores and tasks… by giving me the total of the time needed and by giving me an ending time if I do tasks back to back.

It helps me also to gamify things, as sometimes I try to beat the clock and when I am not in the mood to challenge myself, I have an idea of what time I will be free from chores.

When you add a task on todoist or directly on LlamaLife, add an estimate time in numbers. The app will understand that to do that task it will take xyz amount of time.

For example, by default I have set each task takes 25 mins. But some tasks take less or more. 
So I will write ‘walk dog 90’ meaning the app understands that walking my pup will take an hour and a half.
‘Iron shirts 15’ for the week will take me 15 top as I work from office only 3 days a week, so I have only 3 shirts to iron.

If you suffer from bad time management, try this app.

author: Harribo12345

title: Great product, great support
body:
Absolutely the best time-boxing app out there. For those ADHD’ers who are ‘time blind’, working out what to do when and for how long is a nightmare. This app solves all - and I do mean all - of those problems. I can load in my todo list, put an estimated time for every task, and immediately see how many hours worth of ‘things’ are there. And when I would finish them if I started right away. Invariably I have put far too much on the list. Instead of starting a to-do list and ‘failing’, I can see at the outset that no one could do what I am trying to do. I can change and manage my day from the start. Then I have countdown timers to keep me on task and encourage me to stick to boring tasks. On top of that, it looks amazing and has enough fun features to make me smile and keep coming back to it. And there’s confetti for a job well done. 

The product support is also the best and most responsive you will find.

author: jennaluna

title: The Best!
body:
I love how simple this is to use!  You can create as many presets as you want.  Like, one morning routine for workdays and one for non workdays.  

I have a preset for when company is coming because I always need to clean the bathroom, clean the kitchen, etc.  So I can quickly load the preset and then add anything I need, like if I'm making food ahead of time.  This app tells me how long it's going to take and shows me when I'll finish if I start now.

I love how it shows the overall time, but I don't feel forced into set time blocks and I can change the order of tasks with a quick drag.  So I can have some flexibility, but still get everything done in time.  Standard time blocking has been a nightmare for me.  What if I don't want to start vacuuming at 10:00?  Then I feel like a failure!  This is way better for my brain!

I haven’t made any preset lists yet, I’ll probably wait until I’m able to pay for a subscription and then try those out then. But, just kinda adding tasks throughout the day is working for me on its own. I don’t want to get too overwhelmed with the lists!

author: Lacie Elaine

title: Want to love it, but bugs are bugging me
body:
Llama Life in early 2026 is a half-finished app with distracting quirks. And we all know how ADHDers love a distraction. <s> 
When I name a task, the name is not saved unless I tap “Done” on the keyboard. If I switch apps to, say, check a date or copy a note, the task name will be gone when I return to Llama Life.
Even staying within the app, if I choose an emoji before tapping “Done,” the task name is lost. This is one picky llama and you have to do things her way. 
Just now I had a task list with just one item. I returned to it to add another one, and the list now contained six or seven more tasks all called “Untitled task” and with (appropriately) a “?” emoji on each. I had to clear the whole list and create my task again from scratch. This is not helping! 
This llama also expects you to comply with her rules about moving tasks to the main list before completing them. If you happen to finish tasks without your phone in front of you, and with the task still in the “Later” list, she won’t let you clear it until you move it to the main list and tap “Complete.” 
I do appreciate the app and I want it to improve and succeed. But there are many steps between here and there. By 2027 I hope to update this review and give 5 stars to an indispensable app that I can’t live without and can recommend without hesitation.

author: Sunshine   Rainbows

title: Best customer support
body: I’ve used this app for over a year and it’s the best! Helps me more than any other app or platform has with staying on task. On top of a great product, their team is always so helpful and friendly when you have questions. I bumped into an issue downloading the desktop app on a new work computer and Marie was with me every step of the way!!
author: et921

title: Can't even create a new task unless you pay
body: Obviously I understand that apps usually need to at least have paid subscriptions as an option, or they may even decide to have no free version and only do subscriptions. But I've never had a task management app -- or any app -- let me create an account, take me through a tutorial, and then let me find out that I quite literally can't use it AT ALL without a paid subscription. Like, can't even create a new task, nothing. The app seems like it's probably quite useful, and I understand some companies don't do free versions of their app, but I shouldn't be able to sign up thinking there's going to be a free version because nothing obvious has told me otherwise. I hope the devs will redo things to make it much more clear that you have to buy a subscription to use this app at all, saves some confusion and frustration!
author: j_s11

title: I never knew…!
body: I couldn’t believe how long the smallest of things that we all do in the mornings and evenings take.  Well add ADHD to that and you can see how quickly time gets away from you and you’re constantly late. This app gently helps you to correct that.  Morning changer for me!!
author: Pedriena

title: Apple Watch support and a way to organize your presets would make this perfect
body: Love this app. I think Apple Watch support would make this even better  . Also maybe a way to search your presets would me awesome
author: tf2333

title: Easy to Use!
body: This app is very easy to use, like the 7 day trial period to see if it will really work!  The only app that I’ve been able to get to work for me!
author: strykerrose

title: Incredible
body: Literally just downloaded it but I can already tell this is gonna make my life so much easier. Routines, timers, everything is just perfect. The only unfortunate thing is there’s no iPad app :/ But I can deal with
author: Obsessed Polymath

title: Charged me even though I sent email requested cancellation prior to renewal.
body: Cancelling this app has been impossible. No one replies to email. No way to cancel in app. I sent an email which is what they said to do; got no reply and charged my card anyway. I’d give zero stars if I could.
author: HHSFI

title: I’m hooked!
body:
This is time-boxing for time-boxing-challenged people!! I have tried for years to time box (after other productivity hacks also failed) only to get off track and wind up overwhelmed and discouraged. I actually quit even trying because I knew I would just waste time replanning and re-replanning if the time slipped. And here is the thing Llama Life taught me. Time sometimes does slip. And it’s not a reflection on me. Sometimes a task just takes longer or an interruption happens. And the day isn’t a failure. 

Llama Life has just enough flexibility to adapt to the day’s situation. But not so much that you could go down a rabbit hole playing around in the app instead of moving through the day’s to-do’s. 

I am a paper planner person and have been looking for which one to buy for the new year. I’m so glad I found LL before I purchased my annual planner because I won’t need a day planner at all, just a simple place for my goals and projects. I trust Llama Life to help me keep my days focused and productive. And even fun!!

I will be passing along this gift of joy to many loved ones.
author: SooBeeW

title: Life Changing
body: I seriously don’t know how I ever managed to organize my workday or stay on task before Llama Life. It’s become one of the most important tools in my ADHD toolkit to help me pace and adjust my days without being too rigid or hard on myself. And their customer support is so helpful and genuine! They really are the best and I am loving all of the updates and improvements made since the beginning. 10/10 do recommend!
author: kljelly

title: a different kind of task app, and so helpful
author: gtd-andy010101

title: Sick of paywalls
body: Just be up front and honest with your pricing. I expect to pay for a good app but I immediately delete apps that give no expectation in the description of how the app charges and you don’t get that information until after you “sign up” and the company has your information.
author: Hellena Hanbasquet

title: Life Changing!
body: This app solves my time-blindness issues! Such a clever approach to time-boxing. I’ve tried MANY productivity apps over the years, and this one is my very favorite. (And it pairs well with the GTD method). This app halts my habitual tendency to overbook myself (always thinking I can squish more into a day than can be done. . . leading to overwhelm). Llama life helps me set guard rails and calms my projects—and my mind. Plus the UI is intuitive, pretty, well organized, and whimsical. What a delight. Thank you so much! 5 stars!! No, make that 6. :-)
author: TucsonWriter

title: Best productivity app!!
body: I’ve been using Llama Life for several years now and it’s helped tremendously. I was super happy when the iOS app launched and I use it regularly to help organize my tasks. I love being able to see how long a task list will take (helps with time blindness) and all the fun visual perks help keep it exciting and fun to complete tasks. Devs are very hands-on, responsive, and listen to users when adding and updating features. Cannot recommend this enough!!
author: AkenanM

title: Such a fun and VERY helpful app
body: I absolutely love Llama Life! It makes getting through the workday a joy :)
author: cmaaccc

title: Love this app
body:
I love this. I can set up a morning routine and then it counts down each step of events and how long I expect it to take. Seeing a list with an active count down timer really helps me visualize what I need to do and how much time I have to do it, rather than getting sidetracked.

That said, I really wish this app had some other features (because now I have to use other apps in supplement to this one, which sometimes makes it a bit inconvenient). 
— I wish the in app sound would offer more than just relaxing nature noises but rather a clock/timer tick sound or a water droplet sound that CONTINUES to play even if you exit the app/start playing music. 
— This is one of the biggest things- the timer should be able to show and continue running in the Lock Screen or at least create an interactive widget feature. If I close out of the app and I play music or something, the notification simply says “timer will keep running” rather than a current count down of your task / and the ability to mark as complete/etc. This is the biggest inconvenience of the app compared to other promodoro or task management apps. 
IF the second feature was available, this would genuinely be an app I could not live without and would be such an immense game changer.
author: MacadamiaNuts

title: Simply the best tool for ADHDers
body: This app has done more for my ADHD than anything outside of counseling and medication. It’s the only tool that has stuck and it really helps me move through my day productively. So grateful for this app!
author: Jessewn

title: The best time boxing app
body: Tried hundreds of apps and llama is exactly what I wanted all this time. Simple yet flexible.
author: Julian USA

title: Llama life saves my day, again and again
body: I’ve been using llama life for a year and I absolutely love it. I don’t use it every day but when my ADHD throws me for a loop the llama is there for the rescue this way doesn’t turn into a bad week because by day two the llama gets me back on track. Thank you to the team for the todoist implementation - super convenient . The best part, however, is the “surprise me” color button. 🌈 It’s such a silly thing but I just push that button and I smile! Thank you, Llama team, you are awesome!!!!!
author: Just me again :-)

title: So much potential, yet falls short.
body:
Ever since the 30/30 timer disappeared, I’ve been looking for a replacement.  Llama life looks similar but I can’t figure out how to creat multiple routines that just stay as complete routines to chose from.

If I have to recreate routines each time and then they contribute to AN ENTIRE day as a whole (without the ability to easily mix and match pre-made routines), this is a huge barrier to use.

For instance, I want to be able to create different morning routines (that just live within the app so I can select them), multiple work routines, multiple evening routines, etc.
author: AllGoodUserNamesAreTaken

title: seems awesome!
body: Just started the free trial but I really love this so far! a good friend recommended it and got it set up for me. It reminds me a lot of the function of Routinery which I use for my repeated everyday tasks, and i think the similarity will make this app even more useable for me. Very excited to keep using it!
author: morganfaem

title: Confetti makes life better
body:
I had been using the web version of this app for a while. It is fun which makes me want to use it. Different colors, emojis and confetti when you complete a task. But don’t let the fun interface fool you. This app has a ton of useful features such as chimes to remind you you were working, automatic breaking down of tasks, integration with notion or todoist (which integrates with Evernote), and loads of other things. The team is super responsive to help you if you run into a snag. 
And did o mention the mini celebration when you complete something? Oh, well, it makes using the app fun enough that I actually do it and my productivity is way higher when I am using llama life!!
author: jeliabean

title: live love llama!
body: Llama life is the best app for task organization, timekeeping, motivation, and focus I have found—and believe me, I have tried them all! I had been looking forever for something that could approximate 30/30 (long discontinued, but it was so helpful for me with timeboxing and task completion), and Llama life is it! Especially now that Llama Life is also an app (used to only be on my desktop/laptop) it is even better! Llama life (and the presets, colors, emoji integration, throwing of confetti when you complete tasks) is the best ever. I’d buy stock if I could! They are also super receptive to feedback. All around winning app. Thanks Llama Life!
author: Deanella1976

title: Love Llama Life
body: I love this app! I have tried so many productivity apps, but this is the one for me.
author: Parkersmom

title: Just get this app already
body:
I am lucky enough to be part of the development. This team is dedicated to the community, the development of the app and always a pleasure to communicate with. 

As far as the app- I use it daily. What makes it different is the time shown for each task and the total time for a group of tasks. For example, if I need to do my morning tasks I know it’s a total of 1.5hrs, but I know I have to leave the house in 1hr- then I can adjust the list of tasks and move the tool to show the exact time ie. 8:43AM that it would take to complete all the morning tasks.

I love knowing how long it will take to complete a group of tasks and when that group would be complete. I have over 20+ tasks in a given day. Llama Life is the only way I get these things done!

Pro tip: add a prelist of breaks to add into your task list if you have a hard time taking breaks
author: Bhjddjjj

title: Order out of Chaos
body: We started using the web version in August as a caregiving/med/hydration schedule keeper. The first week I used LlamaLife I got 15+ more hours of sleep from staying right on schedule. We were 30/30 people so we’ve been adrift after accidentally updating the ancient iPad we used that with. But this app was the even-better revelation we needed to help us get and keep on schedule.
author: globaldd

title: Fantastic for ADHD Productivity!
body:
I love Llama Life! I have been using it for over a year, and I'm super excited that it's on iPS now! 

Still missing a couple useful features from the web app like Todoist sync, but the devs are working on it. And you can still set things up on the web, let it sync to mobile, and then go from there.

If you have ADHD, like the idea of pomodoro, but struggle with the other apps out there, this app is the miracle you have been looking for!
author: Luxliquida

title: Excellent app
body: I find Llama life to be so useful and helpful with my day to day productivity. And it’s so fun! I couldn’t live without it.
author: Nattyr2222

title: Live. Laugh. Llama. 💕
body:
For years, there has been a 30/30-shaped hole in my heart, and I have bounced from app to app searching for a worthy replacement. I found the Llama Life website a few weeks ago and was disappointed to see that it was via Internet only, but then I was almost immediately thrilled to read that an iOS app was to release within the month. Talk about perfect timing! 

Words cannot convey how much this app means to me. As an ADHD woman whose sense of time is vestigial at best, finding a app that works with my brain is like birthday and Christmas rolled into one. 30/30 worked for me, and then it just… went away. 😭 I mourned that app the way other people might mourn lost family members. There is no telling how much time and money I’ve wasted searching for a replacement, but the search is finally over! HUZZAH. (That’s what the kids say nowadays, right??)

To the developers of Llama Life, thank you thank you THANK YOU for all of your hard work. All of the features, the colors, emoji, the ability to break tasks down, to save routines, to easily enter times, the end time estimate, the planned vs. actual time, the divider bar… This app feels like it was designed especially for me. I cannot wait to see where you take it, and I’ll be a subscriber all the way!
author: katlady

title: The only app I use for managing my day!
body:
I’ve been using Llama Life on desktop for about ten months, and it simplifies and gameifies the dreaded daily to-do list. So to now have this handy system on my phone really transforms the entire day for me! I’m able to manage my tasks as I’m doing them in different rooms of the house, or even out and about running errands! As an ADHDer, this is especially helpful as I can get detailed so easily and succumb to distractions and side quests!

My favorite part of Llama Life is how they’ve managed to make something like a boring to-do list into something fun! Confetti, chimes, and the colors and themes just make it more appealing. I save my preset lists for routine-setting, check over my reports to see if I stuck to my time estimation, and even use their AI-assisted emoji matching to make those tasks even more fun. 

Can’t wait to see what’s next for Llama Life!
author: Isabella_ringaling

title: My favorite productivity app
body: Using it is such a pleasant experience. The app is simple and very fun to use. Recommend to anyone 🦙🦙🦙🦙🦙
author: damengchen

title: Great daily productivity tool!
body: I’ve been using Llama Life desktop for a year. I link it to Todoist. Every morning it brings up the things to spend time on for that day. I use it for both the everyday (workout, reach out reminders) to specific tasks (write memo etc). It fundamentally changes your understanding of where you spend your time so that you can set right expectations and prioritize the most important things to you. I love it and highly recommend.
author: TomAtlanta

title: I love Llama Life and I use it everyday
body: The iOS app is a great addition to the web app and has a great look and feel. So cool to finally a native version of this app!
author: AndreeasDST

title: A unique and interesting way to motivate people
body: This app approached motivation differently than most other apps out there and it works! I love all the small carefully crafted details to keep me motivated and long the right path, and would highly recommend everyone check it out!
author: thebarbican

title: The best app for getting things done!
body:
Huge fan of this company, what they offer, how helpful they are, and the look of the app.

There is not a single app out there on the market like Llama Life! You can fully customize your task lists, create built-in templates, break tasks down when your list overwhelms you, let you start with a random task, and so so much more.
author: Jpbd97547

title: Game changer!
body: Llama life has changed my life! It helps me focus and be realistic about what can and cannot be done in a day. The audio cues are so helpful in maintaining focus. Their support team has been amazing with questions. Highly recommend!
author: cindywhitesides

title: Love This App
body: Love this app since it’s web-only days! Great to have it on the iPhone.
author: Dave the Student

title: Personal Game Changer
body: I have been using the web app for some time now with tremendous results to my personal journey with ADD and time blindness. Now with the IOS app I can be more productive away from my desk. Super stoked. Thanks to the developers for bringing this to market.
author: Thadisfree

title: Fun Way to Stay Intentional
body: So glad the mobile app is here. This app that wants to protect your time, attention and focus for what you want to do when so many other apps want to consume your attention.
author: Voracious Learning

title: I’m a Llama for Life!
body:
I have ADHD and, as an entrepreneur who must focus on tasks to get them DONE (as opposed to partially done in a thousand open tabs), Llama Life has been a lifesaver. Every aspect of the app (which I’ve been using on desktop for years) is a delight, from the colors to the icons to the branding… it even helps me break down my tasks into steps if I get stuck. Something about knowing I only have to do an unpleasant task for 20 minutes and then I can do something else… while listening to a focus-inducing soundscape… it makes the impossible possible.

This is SUCH a worthwhile app. There is none other like it… and believe me, I have tried DOZENS of apps. This one is both practical and delightful. It’s beautifully executed. I’m so glad I found it!

Also, who doesn’t llove llamas?🦙
author: Norm E

title: Excited for the iOS app version!
body:
I started using Llama Life on the web awhile back, along with a lot of my coworkers. It’s a huge help with work tasks, and I’ve been really excited for the iOS app to make it easier to use for personal tasks. It really does help my brain stay on track, and it’s fun to use.

Congrats on launching the app, Llama Life team!
author: Petuniabishco
